title: Uphill relay
description: A steel ball hangs in the air at (40, 280), top left, and falls from the start. Three short fixed posts, each a level beam 30 cm long: post a runs from x = 105 to 135 with its top at y = 232; post b from x = 195 to 225 with its top at y = 42, just above the floor; post c from x = 305 to 335 with its top at y = 112, 70 cm higher than b. A bell hangs at (350, 75) from a bracket 20 cm above it. The build zone covers x from 20 to 380 and y from 2 to 290. Something moving has to touch a, then b, then c, in that order, before anything rings the bell. Nothing rolling off b can reach c; something has to be sent up to it. Chain length is scored too.
